showcase: Drop a .dsh/mcp.yml in a repo and its MCP servers mount only for sessions in that project, with live reload and per-tool allow/deny.
summary: Loads MCP servers from per-project .dsh/mcp.yml or mcp.json (plus legacy .mcp.json), hot-reloads on file change, hides tools per session project, and ships a dsh-mcp CLI and a settings page service.
